baseline.name: summarize-health-findings

files.content:
---
name: summarize-health-findings
description: Summarize existing redacted Autohealth finding JSON when reviewing repeated checks. Does not inspect repositories or apply fixes.
---

Use supplied redacted finding JSON. Preserve the root, fingerprint, severity and every evidence reference; a repeated finding is not a new defect. Input is an array of objects with root, fingerprint, severity and evidence.

Run `node scripts/summarize.mjs <input.json>` from this skill directory and inspect the JSON output. The script only reads the selected input and writes its result to stdout. Report unsupported inputs rather than inventing evidence. Keep heuristic findings uncertain and distinguish absence of evidence from a successful check. The summary grants no permission to change a repository, test, instruction or active skill.

baseline.problem: A portable read-only summary procedure is not yet an active product skill.
baseline.benefit: Preserve complete supplied finding evidence without requiring the platform.
evidence: initial portable procedure; not installed or active

metrics.window: Most recent 200 generation tasks and 100 maintenance records; not an all-time or wall-clock window.

definitions.generation: Validated and explicitly applied implementation tasks / recorded implementation tasks. Failed, cancelled, interrupted and running attempts stay in the denominator. Preflight rejections before task creation are unavailable, not counted as eligible tasks.
definitions.reuse: Completed plans explicitly referencing at least one existing capability / completed implementation tasks; this is a plan-level reuse proxy, not opportunity-level coverage.
definitions.maintenance: Reviewed current-executable locator-defect diagnoses with at least one validated/applied repair / reviewed current-executable locator-defect diagnoses. Reversal is reported separately.
definitions.providerTokens: Expose recorded fields from the task total once. Cached input and reasoning output can be subsets; they are not added again to input/output/total. Absent fields remain null.
definitions.queries: Repeated normalized exact query hash with identical indexed root tree hashes within a task; semantic similarity is not inferred.
definitions.invocation: Execution-trusted fixed-bundle CLI invocations, including evaluations and explicit active-summary workflows, scoped to bundle hash. External Codex invocations are unavailable.

repositoryAnalysis.meaning: Last stored bounded scan; cache-hit ratio is not token savings or a source-freshness guarantee.

metrics.claim: No model-token savings, provider cost or general agent-quality improvement established. Deterministic script comparison is reported separately.
